title: TimezoneLookupResponse
description:
Response returned by the Timezone Lookup API.

Contains timezone information for the requested identifier such as a
timezone name, IP address, geographic coordinates, location address,
airport code (IATA/ICAO), or UN/LOCODE.

Depending on the lookup method used, additional contextual objects may
be returned:

- `ip` appears when the lookup is performed using an IP address or when
  no parameters are provided (caller IP lookup).
- `location` appears when the lookup is performed using an IP address
  or location address.
- `airport_details` appears when the lookup is performed using
  `iata_code` or `icao_code`.
- `lo_code_details` appears when the lookup is performed using
  `lo_code`.

The `time_zone` object is always present in the response.

ip.description:
The IP address used to determine the timezone. This field appears
only when the lookup is performed using an IP address or when the
API resolves the caller's IP automatically.

location.description:
Geolocation information associated with the requested IP address
or location query.

This object appears when the timezone lookup is performed using
the `ip` or `location` parameters.

It provides geographic details such as continent, country,
administrative regions, and coordinates used to determine the
corresponding timezone.

location_string.description: Original location string provided in the request.

country_name_official.example: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

is_eu.description: Indicates whether the country is a member of the European Union.

locality.description: Smaller locality or neighborhood within the city.

zipcode.description: ZIP or postal code of the location.

airport_details.description:
Airport information returned when the timezone lookup is performed
using `iata_code` or `icao_code`.

Contains metadata about the airport including its geographic
coordinates, country, and airport identifiers.

type.description: Classification of the airport based on size and traffic.

elevation_ft.description: Airport elevation above sea level measured in feet.

continent_code.description: Two-letter continent code where the airport is located.

state_code.description: State or province code where the airport is located.

faa_code.description: FAA location identifier used primarily in the United States.

lo_code_details.description:
City or logistics location information returned when the timezone
lookup is performed using a UN/LOCODE.

UN/LOCODE is a five-character identifier consisting of a two-letter
country code followed by a three-character location identifier.

lo_code.description: UN/LOCODE representing the city or logistics location.

city.description: Name of the city associated with the UN/LOCODE.

state_code.description: State or region code of the location.

country_name.description: Name of the country where the location exists.

location_type.description:
Type of facilities available at the location such as port,
rail terminal, road terminal, airport, or postal exchange.
location_type.example: Port, Rail Terminal, Road Terminal, Airport, Postal Exchange

time_zone.description:
Detailed timezone information for the requested location or identifier.

Contains timezone metadata such as UTC offset, daylight saving time (DST)
status, formatted timestamps, and DST transition information.

name.description: IANA timezone identifier for the location.

offset.description: Standard timezone offset from UTC in hours.

offset_with_dst.description: Timezone offset from UTC including daylight saving time.

date_time.description: Current date and time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` format.

date_time_wti.description: Date and time with timezone information.

date_time_ymd.description: ISO-8601 formatted date and time with timezone offset.

current_time_unix.description: Unix timestamp representing the current date and time.

week.description: Week number of the current year.

current_tz_abbreviation.description: Abbreviation of the timezone currently in effect.

current_tz_full_name.description: Full name of the timezone currently in effect.

standard_tz_full_name.description: Full name of the standard timezone.

is_dst.description: Indicates whether daylight saving time is currently active.

dst_savings.description: Number of hours added during daylight saving time.

dst_exists.description: Indicates whether the region observes daylight saving time.

dst_tz_abbreviation.description: Abbreviation used during daylight saving time.

dst_tz_full_name.description: Full name used during daylight saving time.

dst_start.description:
Represents a daylight saving time transition event including the
moment when DST begins or ends.

utc_time.description: UTC timestamp when the DST transition occurs.

duration.description: Time change applied during the transition.

gap.description: Indicates whether an hour is skipped during the transition.

date_time_after.description: Local date and time immediately after the DST change.

date_time_before.description: Local date and time immediately before the DST change.

overlap.description: Indicates whether clock time overlaps during the transition.

dst_end.description:
Represents a daylight saving time transition event including the
moment when DST begins or ends.

utc_time.description: UTC timestamp when the DST transition occurs.

duration.description: Time change applied during the transition.

gap.description: Indicates whether an hour is skipped during the transition.

date_time_after.description: Local date and time immediately after the DST change.

date_time_before.description: Local date and time immediately before the DST change.

overlap.description: Indicates whether clock time overlaps during the transition.
